scope: Venue-level opportunity for the original broad interests; no scheduled activity fulfillment, date availability, admission or current exhibition guarantee.
interpretation: Modern art includes ordinary modern and contemporary visual art, including expressly artistic audiovisual/projection works. Traditional culture needs described cultural substance; identity, aesthetic associations and genre names alone are insufficient. Explicitly located complex components may establish opportunity, without assuming admission or a child-venue visit. Older isolated exhibitions do not alone establish current opportunity; continuing institutional programs can establish thematic relevance without a trip-date guarantee.
evidence_limitations: Saved independent factual paraphrases and their limitations were reviewed. Full original web responses and page bodies were not reopened; source accuracy beyond these saved descriptions was not independently re-fetched. Identity metadata served only as lookup binding.
